notes.zh-CN: 修复新建实体的字段规则可能失效的问题。移动端的空状态文案弹窗改为靠上显示，关闭节点设置的子弹窗后会回到原来的编辑位置。
notes.en: Fixed an issue where field rules could stop working after a new entity was saved. On mobile, the empty-state message dialog now opens higher on the screen. Closing a dialog opened from the node editor now restores your scroll position.
